text: Goreng wakes on level 48 of a vast vertical prison, [volunteered for six months in exchange for a diploma|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. Once a day a platform heaped with food descends from level 0, and [those above gorge while those below starve|wrong|selfish appetites]. Each month the prisoners are moved at random, and his cellmate Trimagasi admits that on level 132 [they ate a man to survive|threat|people who kill]. A silent woman named Miharu rides the platform down searching for a child, and Goreng begins to wonder whether [the system itself|threat|the powerful and their systems] can be sent a message.
